items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In any case, you got there before Nixon huh? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Well that was his premise to begin with, he was waiting to go with Jean Goldkette and his orchestra with Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy Dorsey Joe Venuti, excuse me, and well he left to go with them. I stayed with the Wolverines and we went down to the Cinderalla Ballroom and we were there for about six or eight weeks I guess. We went to Florida and we were going to open up in a place on the Biscayne Bay, what was it, the Round House? I've forgotten.
In any case, you got there before Nixon huh? (LAUGHTER).
Yes. But what happened was the night we were supposed to open we came there and the Federal Agents closed on account of the eighteenth amendment. The Prohibition, it was during Prohibition.
